about_the_game:
Pioneers is a relaxing building strategy and puzzle game where you terraform barren planets into beautiful habitable ecosystems. Immerse yourself in a peaceful world as you bring life and colour to desolate planets. At the same time, Pioneers offers a challenge for those who are looking for one: To beat the highscore, carefully plan and strategically place your pieces to score the most points. 

In Pioneers you set out across the galaxy to make a new home for humankind. Here you will begin placing buildings to form your first colony and start to terraform the land into a colourful planet to call home again. With each piece you place you will be rewarded with points depending on how well you place it or what surrounds it at the time. 

As you cleanse the toxic air of planets you will discover hidden objectives here you might come across ancient alien technology or hidden resources to aid you but watch out you may trigger a natural distaster as you contend with errupting volcanos or a planetary ice age.    

Once your planet can sustain life you have the choice to stay or venture deeper into the unknown in search of perfect planet to call home.

What Pioneers offers

  • Transforming wastelands into beautiful landscapes

  • A mix of strategy and puzzle mechanics

  • Relaxing and calming gameplay (unless a volcano errupts)

  • Strategic placement to beat the highscore

  • High replay value - every session is different with procedurally generated planets

What Pioneers does not offer

  • 4X Strategy

  • Trading

  • Resource Management

  • Combat & Violence

  • Multiplayer
